title: Native extension fails after runner compiler update
root_cause: The newer runner image supplies GCC 14 instead of GCC 13. The native extension calls a C function without a declaration; GCC 14 treats that diagnostic as an error, so its wheel cannot be built. The Python changes in the comparison do not affect the extension build.

relevant_evidence.why: The runner compiler identifies itself as GCC 14.
The native extension build fails on an implicit function declaration.
The call precedes the function declaration.
